title: Describing Your Daily Routine
context: Putting the whole day together: sequencing words and natural time expressions that turn a word list into fluent speech. This is the scenario that ties all the others together.
contextPersian: کنار هم گذاشتن کل روز: کلمات ترتیب و عبارت‌های زمانی طبیعی که فهرست لغات را به صحبت روان تبدیل می‌کنند. این سناریو بقیه را به هم وصل می‌کند.

expressions.example: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.
expressions.examplePersian: اول صبح پیام‌هایم را چک می‌کنم.

expressions.example: I have breakfast, and after that I head to work.
expressions.examplePersian: صبحانه می‌خورم و بعد از آن راهی سر کار می‌شوم.

expressions.example: By the time I get home, it's usually dark.
expressions.examplePersian: تا وقتی به خانه می‌رسم معمولاً هوا تاریک شده.
expressions.note: Very natural for linking times: by the time X happens, Y has happened.

expressions.example: I take a short break around eleven.
expressions.examplePersian: حدود ساعت یازده یک استراحت کوتاه می‌کنم.

expressions.example: I usually grab lunch with a colleague at one.
expressions.examplePersian: معمولاً ساعت یک با یک همکار ناهار می‌خورم.

expressions.example: I try to wrap up work by six.
expressions.examplePersian: سعی می‌کنم تا شش کار را جمع کنم.
expressions.note: Wrap up = finish. Also: let's wrap up the meeting.

expressions.example: In the evening I wind down with a book or a show.
expressions.examplePersian: شب‌ها با کتاب یا سریال آرام می‌گیرم.

expressions.example: I stayed up late last night, so I'm exhausted.
expressions.examplePersian: دیشب تا دیروقت بیدار ماندم، برای همین خسته‌ام.

expressions.example: I'm trying to get a good night's sleep before the interview.
expressions.examplePersian: سعی می‌کنم قبل از مصاحبه یک خواب شبانه خوب داشته باشم.

expressions.example: On weekdays I'm very busy, but on weekends I relax.
expressions.examplePersian: روزهای هفته خیلی سرم شلوغ است اما آخر هفته‌ها استراحت می‌کنم.

exercises.prompt: You finish work at six. The most natural way to say it:
options: I wrap up work by six.
I conclude the work at six.
I am closing works at six.

exercises.after: late watching the match, so I overslept.
exercises.explanation: Stay up late — تا دیروقت بیدار ماندن.
By the time + clause, main clause.
exercises.explanationPersian: ساختار by the time برای ربط دو زمان.

exercises.source: شب‌ها با یک کتاب آرام می‌گیرم.
acceptedAnswers: In the evening I wind down with a book.
In the evenings I wind down with a book.
At night I wind down with a book.
exercises.explanation: Wind down — آرام گرفتن آخر روز.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence sequences a day naturally?
options: First thing in the morning I check email, and after that I start coding.
Firstly morning I check email, secondly coding.
At the first of morning email, then after codes.
In morning one: email. In morning two: coding.
exercises.explanation: Natural sequencing: first thing in the morning..., after that...
exercises.explanationPersian: ترتیب طبیعی: first thing in the morning و after that.

speakingTask.instruction: Describe your whole day in 6-8 sentences, using at least three sequencing expressions.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: کل روزت را در ۶ تا ۸ جمله توصیف کن و حداقل از سه عبارت ترتیبی استفاده کن.
modelSentences: First thing in the morning, my alarm goes off at six.
After that, I take a quick shower and grab breakfast.
I take a break around eleven and grab lunch at one.
I try to wrap up work by six.
By the time I get home, I'm ready to wind down.
On weekends, I stay up late and sleep in.

roleplay.aiRole: A new online language partner getting to know the learner
roleplay.learnerRole: You're telling a new conversation partner about your typical day
roleplay.objective: Describe a full day fluently and answer follow-up questions
roleplay.context: First chat with a language partner who is curious about the learner's daily life — work, meals, evenings, weekends. They ask natural follow-ups.
roleplay.opening: So tell me — what does a typical day look like for you?
